posts.text:
I remember sitting around a campfire shortly after the Ukraine war had just started with some Ukrainian friends.

They shared that after they learned that Russian forces were jamming all communications they called Elon begging for Starlink support.

Elon and the Starlink team instantly dropped everything they were working on, loaded a private jet with as many Starlink terminals as they could (terminals were in short supply at the time), and started flying the jet eastward while writing code to make terminals work over Ukraine.

There was no contract or promise of payment for doing so, and no time to solve for that.

My Ukrainian friends believed this saved the nation of Ukraine, and that without this effort Ukraine would have lost the war nearly instantly.

James Talarico is a radical extremist.

I crunched the numbers on his voting record.

I show it.

Whenever there was a disagreement between Republicans and Democrats in the Texas House during Talarico's time as a Texas Representative from 2019 to 2025, Talarico sided with Democrats 96.8% of the time.

He sided with Republicans less often than 194 of 210 House members.

Only 15 of 82 Democrats were more extreme.

This puts his voting record in the top 7% most extreme left-wing among Texas House Representatives.

In 2026, being an extreme Democrat is really cuckoo.

For comparison, in 2021, the unhinged Jasmine Crockett was in the Texas House with Talarico.

During that year, Crockett voted with Republicans 2.34% of the time. Talarico voted with them 2.38% of the time.

Talarico's numbers were virtually the same as Jasmine Crockett's.

Talarico has claimed that "God is non-binary" and that his goal is to "dismantle" "capitalism, white supremacy, and climate change".

Now we can say with confidence that his voting record tells the same story as his words did -- until he recently suddenly changed his tune.

Talarico's "views" started miraculously "changing" in the past few months.

They became, as he says, "moderate", when he started campaigning against Ken Paxton for the U.S. Senate seat.

What a coincidence.

Talarico is lying.

Talarico is a loony hiding his real views.

He knows that voters would never elect him if he told them truth.

So he doesn't.
